# TreeStoreValueBanding registers its test class in beforeAll, so a second run in one worker collides

## Context

`data/TreeStoreValueBanding.spec.mjs:194` is one of the four intermittent arms #19039's instrument was built to measure. CI reported it as `1 flaky / 4259 passed` on 2026-09-19. The instrument's first hosted probe on `dev@526b65e0ee`, `--repeat-each=50` ([35807579596](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/35807579596)), measured **1 flaky in 150**:

```
Error: Namespace collision in unitTestMode for Test.Unit.Data.TreeStoreValueBanding.TestTreeModel
```

Locally, `npm run test-unit -- …/TreeStoreValueBanding.spec.mjs --repeat-each=50 --workers=4 --retries=0` gives **3 failed / 147 passed**, all three that same collision.

Sweeps: the latest 20 open issues at 2026-09-23T01:53:28Z hold no equivalent. There is no lane claim. The nearest prior art is #18776, a different unit-isolation leak, closed.

## The Problem

The spec defines `TestTreeModel` inside its `describe` and registers it in `test.beforeAll(() => { TestModel = Neo.setupClass(TestTreeModel); })`, then never removes it. The unit config runs `fullyParallel: true` on 4 workers with 2 retries in CI. A worker can execute `beforeAll` more than once for this `describe` (repeats, or separate groups of its three tests). The second `Neo.setupClass` finds the namespace taken, and `unitTestMode` throws (`src/Neo.mjs:875-882`). The retry runs in a fresh worker and passes, so the report reads "flaky".

## The Architectural Reality

- `Neo.setupClass` in `unitTestMode` throws when a non-singleton re-registers a taken namespace. That is deliberate (`src/Neo.mjs:869-874`): two distinct classes sharing a name is a test-isolation leak.
- 85 unit spec files register their test classes at module scope, which runs once per worker process because modules are cached. This spec is the only one that registers inside `beforeAll`.

## The Fix

Register `TestTreeModel` at module scope, the idiom the other 85 files use: define the class and run `Neo.setupClass` once, outside `beforeAll`. No engine change.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `--repeat-each=50 --workers=4 --retries=0` on the spec: 0 failed, 150 passed.
- [ ] Mutation: moving the registration back into `beforeAll` restores the collision under the same command.
- [ ] The three tests' assertions are unchanged.

## Out of Scope

- `unitTestMode`'s collision rule. It is correct, and this spec broke it.
- The other three intermittent arms (#19039).

## Decision Record impact

None.
